GetPurchasableDiskInformationNew.clientToken: Idempotency Token, an ASCII string of no more than 64 characters. See [Idempotency](BCC/API参考/通用说明.md#幂等性) for details.
GetPurchasableDiskInformationNew.zoneName: Zone information. The naming convention for zoneName is "country-region-availability zone sequence" in lowercase, e.g., Beijing availability zone A is "cn-bj-a".
